profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary: I am currently a Lead Software Engineer who holds a management position at CapitalOne

positions.title: Manager | Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Oversees technical direction and architecture for software projects, ensuring solutions are scalable maintainable, and align with organizational goals. 
- Leads and mentors engineering teams, providing guidance on coding standards, design patterns, and professional development. 
- Collaborates cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to define project requirements, scope, and priorities. 
- Reviews and approves code changes, conducting peer reviews to maintain quality, performance, and security best practices. 
- Drives process improvements in development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, testing, and deployment to enhance team efficiency and reliability. 
- Manages project timelines and resource allocation, balancing hands-on technical contributions with leadership responsibilities. 
- Monitor system performance and reliability, coordinating incident responses, and implementing preventive measure for future resilience.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leading and managing a team of software engineers
- Providing technical guidance and mentorship to team members
- Collaborating with stakeholders to define project requirements and scope
- Overseeing the design, development, and implementation of software solutions
- Ensuring code quality, scalability, and performance of applications
- Managing project timelines and resources effectively
- Conducting code reviews and providing feedback for improvement
- Identifying technical risks and proposing mitigation strategies
- Participating in the recruitment and onboarding of new team members
- Keeping abreast of industry trends and best practices in software development
- Communicating effectively with cross-functional teams and senior management
- Fostering a collaborative and innovative team culture
- Upholding high standards of professionalism, ethics, and integrity in all interactions

My role as a Principal Software Engineer requires a blend of technical expertise, leadership skills, and a strategic mindset to drive successful software development projects and ensure the continued growth and success of the team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designing, developing, and testing software applications
- Writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define project requirements
- Participating in code reviews to ensure quality and consistency
- Debugging and troubleshooting software issues
- Implementing software solutions that meet project deadlines
- Adhering to coding standards and best practices
- Researching and implementing new technologies to improve software development
- Documenting software designs, test cases, and user manuals
- Contributing to the continuous improvement of software development processes
- Keeping up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies
- Communicating effectively with team members and stakeholders

As a Software Engineer, I played a crucial role in creating innovative software solutions, solving complex technical challenges, and contributing to the success of software development projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Wrote HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to display dynamic and immersive web applications in modern web browsers.
- Developed back-end web applications and APIs using a modern programming language, RESTful patterns, and the MVC web development framework.
- Developed dynamic front-end applications using Angular.
- Consumed web APIs from third-party sites like Twitter, Facebook, and Yelp.
- Learned the process of deployment to cloud services
- Collaborated within a team using an agile development workflow and collaboration practices in Git.

positions.title: Nomex®  Paper Manufacturing Technology Engineer - Lead Co-op
positions.description:
- Assisted with the implementation of a $20 million dollar capital project to completely demolish, reinstall, and commission a new state of the art press section for our Nomex® Paper forming machine.
- Facilitated a quality/runtime improvement project to enhance the functionality and consistent operation on a piece of critical service equipment responsible for the filtration of our Nomex® ingredients. 
- Performed weekly consistency and biological measurements throughout the Nomex® process to ensure our systems were on aim and to ensure there was no biological growth, which often was the reason for Forming defects.

positions.title: Tyvek® Manufacturing Technology Engineer - Co-op
positions.description:
- Facilitated the upgrades and alignment of in-area lab equipment between the Luxembourg and Richmond labs to ensure consistent quality checks of manufactured product 
- Performed data acquisition, interpretation, and research utilizing Excel for multiple engineers within the Tyvek® bonding department
- Led maintenance projects focused on improving manufacturing capabilities which included the improvement of the optical surveillance system for Tyvek® manufacturing lines

positions.title: Kevlar® Ballistics Applications and Research Engineer - Co-op
positions.description:
- Conducted comparative ballistic performance testing of DuPont Kevlar® with competitors’ products to study results and determine a competitive advantage
- Performed extensive research on the possibility of utilizing Kevlar® as a military grade under-layer to aid in the protection of soldiers from shrapnel blasts
- Worked with area engineers and researchers as a part of a multi-disciplinary team to complete large group projects.

positions.title: HVAC Technician Assistant/Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
- Researched competitive prices, and quoted customer repairs while ensuring cost and quality remained constant
- Assisted technicians with the installation and removal of industrial grade HVAC systems as well as helped perform preventative maintenance of current systems 
- Conducted data entry and acquisition using Excel to increase the efficiency of project management

positions.title: Laser Technician
positions.description:
- Maintained working order of ten universal lasers utilized in the production of intricate wooden cottage ornaments 
- Performed daily maintenance of each universal laser to ensure quality production, and minimized downtime
- Conducted daily oversight of packaging and shipping to ensure deliverables were in line to meet supply needs and critical demand deadlines

positions.title: Fire Proofing Technician
positions.description:
- Managed job site requirements, including but not limited to, project deadlines, material utilization and                                   delivery, and employee supervision
- Performed daily oversight of job site cleanliness to ensure that company and environmental standards were meet

educations.fieldOfStudy: Mechanical Engineering with a Minor in Computer Science

honors.title: President's List
honors.description: Completed my Fall 2015, Spring 2016, and Spring 2017 with a 4.0 GPA

projects.title: Metal 3D Printer Utilizing Selective Laser Sintering (SLS) - Capstone Project
projects.description: This senior design project aims to design, develop, and manufacture an affordable dekstop 3D Metal Printer. Prices of current 3D metal printers are prohibitively expensive, and often times very large for there given application. This project will span from August 2018 to May 2019. During this time, our team will design, develop, and ultimately manufacture a fully functional prototype of our design. This project will involves skills which include but are not limited too: Programming, 3D Design and Analysis, Mechatronics, System Integration and many more.
